page.overview:
What is Final Dungeon?

Final Dungeon is a location in Final Fantasy Legend II. This dungeon is very long compared to the other dungeons, and the player should be prepared before entering.

The party comes here in search of the last MAGI. Upon reaching the end of the dungeon, the party faces against WarMach who is protecting the final MAGI. Upon its destruction, the party claims the last MAGI.
